character.name:
A mysterious moonlit assassin called the Ghost of the Bamboo Veil.

A slender ninja dressed in layered pale-gray and midnight-blue robes designed to blend into foggy night environments. Unlike a traditional dark ninja, this one has an eerie almost ghostlike appearance. The fabric is lightweight and ragged at the edges, constantly drifting as if moved by invisible wind.

The face is hidden behind a smooth white ceramic mask painted with thin black markings resembling tears. Only glowing pale-blue eyes are visible through narrow slits. Long white hair tied into a high ponytail flows behind the character during movement.

The ninja wields a thin elegant nodachi slightly longer than a normal katana. The blade has a reflective moon-silver finish and leaves faint blue afterimages during attacks. Several enchanted paper talismans are attached to the sword handle and armor pieces.

Around the waist hangs a collection of small smoke bombs, bells, and charms stolen from ancient shrines. Thin ropes wrap around the forearms and calves for mobility and grip while climbing.

Special mystical detail:
The ninja’s shadow moves a fraction slower than the body itself, creating an unsettling supernatural effect.

Idle animation ideas:

Cloth and ponytail flowing softly
Talisman papers fluttering slightly
Eyes glowing brighter occasionally
Small mist particles appearing around the feet
Sword emitting a faint moonlight shimmer

Color palette:

Midnight blue
Pale gray
Moonlight silver
Cold cyan glow
White cloth accents
Subtle black shadows

Style:

Elegant supernatural ninja
Calm and deadly aesthetic
Designed for a cinematic pixel art stealth/action game with mystical themes
